instruction: Enable blockchain-based document authentication with cryptographic signatures to verify document authorship and prevent tampering.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have blockchain integration or distributed ledger technology for document authentication. While LibreOffice supports digital signatures using X.509 certificates, it has no blockchain-based authentication system that would require cryptocurrency wallets, smart contracts, or distributed consensus mechanisms.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible' marker for a task that cannot be completed
Blockchain-based document authentication is not available in LibreOffice Writer
The requested functionality requires external infrastructure (blockchain network, cryptocurrency wallets, smart contracts) that doesn't exist in the application
LibreOffice only supports X.509 certificate-based digital signatures, not blockchain-based authentication
Using 'infeasible' is the appropriate semantic response for impossible tasks
